title: Read single-value and multi-value fields in the form
goal: Use FormData to read successfully submitted controls, and use getAll to obtain all values ​​with the same name.
summary: Event registration can check multiple sessions. After submission, a short receipt will be generated on this page, and the input content and browsing position will be retained.
tasks: Prevent default submission in the submit listener of #application, and then use FormData to read the visitor and all sessions.
Write the receipt in #receipt as “NAME: SESSION”. Join multiple sessions with a comma and a space. If none are selected, show “No sessions selected” after the name.

example.note: FormData takes the value according to the name of the control. For check boxes with the same name, use getAll.

hint: Only checked checkboxes enter FormData. When the array is empty, unselected events are displayed.
